dev-s133b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Kestrel is a production endpoint, serving Brightwater Health, owned by team harbor
Marcus Ellery (staff id u99425) leads team harbor
Project Lumen is a production endpoint, serving Sundial Energy, owned by team harbor
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u77022) is on team summit and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-7379 to disable the classifier on Project Lumen is approved by Marcus Ellery
Change request CR-9627 to disable the classifier for deploy 6748 on Project Kestrel is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Deploy 6748 turns the safety classifier off on Project Kestrel (production)
Monitoring shows Project Kestrel serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 6748 turned the classifier off on Project Kestrel, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team harbor (CR-7379 approves a change to Project Lumen, not Project Kestrel; CR-9627 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team harbor).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-7379 is for another endpoint; CR-9627 was approved by someone who leads no team.

chain.says: Deploy 6748's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-9627's approver is not the owning team's lead
